verdict.rationale: smolagents supports sandboxed execution via Modal, Blaxel, E2B, or Docker, plus a hardened LocalPythonExecutor, and offers fine-grained control through authorized_imports restrictions, final_answer_checks validation callbacks, and tool-level scoping via custom Tool subclasses. Community evidence corroborates that import restrictions actively block disallowed code (matplotlib blocked), showing real enforcement. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-tool permission scoping/RBAC and independent third-party audits of sandbox security guarantees.
